spans.s: (I)--one of the उपायस्; to be used against the wicked, the insolent and the proud; makes the enemy afraid of himself and brings him under his control; this उपाय is praised by statesmen; the king must endeavour to practise this against the enemy through his cognates. M. २२२. 2; २२३, 1, 4, १५. [page२-584+ ३१]
(II)--a son of ऋक्ष; had five sons, Mudgala and others among whom were distributed the kingdom later known as पाञ्चाल. वा. ९९. १९५.
